Three BJP Workers Convicted in 2016 Kerala CPM Leader Murder

A Kerala court has convicted three Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) workers in connection with the 2016 murder of Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)] leader C. V. Dhanaraj. Sixteen other individuals accused in the case were acquitted. The conviction marks the outcome of the trial for the 2016 incident.
